name: A Level Business: Stakeford
subtitle: Labs, mocks & case studies
shortDescription: Learn A Level Business by doing: 12 interactive labs, adaptive quizzes, mock papers, case studies and an essay coach. Free to start, optional Stakeford Plus.
longDescription:
Stakeford is an independent revision app for A Level Business. Learn each idea, test yourself, then use it: move break-even charts, forecast cash flow, appraise investments, read ratios, build decision trees and plan a critical path.

### What You Get
- 87 lessons covering the topics in the AQA 7132, Pearson Edexcel 9BS0 and OCR H431 specifications, each with a hook, key terms, a worked example, common slips, a chain of reasoning and evaluation lenses.
- 783 original practice questions with explanations, adaptive quizzes that start with your weakest topics, and a link back to the lesson after every mistake.
- 12 interactive labs and 6 real-world builds: start a bakery, price a launch, choose how to fund a factory, turn a business around, go abroad and cut costs without losing quality.
- Case studies with real calculations, an essay coach with a plan and an evaluation checklist, a command-word trainer and board-style mock papers with timers.
- Syllabus order or Real-World view: follow the specification or learn through the problems a business faces.
- Coverage screen with exact counts, an Other boards map and a Curriculum map comparing topics with GCSE Business, IB Business Management and AP Business with Personal Finance.
- Text size from 50% to 300%, made for phones and tablets, works offline.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
